integrity.classification_basis: An exact consecutive-degree ratio proves that degree divided by 2^n is strictly increasing after n=3, leaving only explicit base values.
integrity.degree_basis: Repeated codimension-one Pieri multiplication counts shifted standard tableaux of staircase shape, and the shifted hook-length formula gives the stated product.
integrity.euler_basis: The integral Schubert basis is indexed by strict partitions with largest part at most n, hence by subsets of {1,...,n}.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The earliest cited public preprint is arXiv:math/0112261, version 1 dated 2001-12-23.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the minimal half-spin polarization only.
It compares projective degree with ordinary topological Euler characteristic and does not identify a direct geometric correspondence between their counting problems.
Both input formulas are classical, so an older unindexed source may contain the same numerical threshold.
title: A sharp degree–Euler threshold for spinor varieties
